explication: APKDeepLens is a command-line Android APK static-analysis tool. Its principal workflow takes an APK (or extracted source), decompiles it with bundled JADX, analyzes the manifest and decompiled code for security issues, then exports severity- and OWASP-tagged findings in a selected report format. The main entry point coordinates the sampled analysis modules; the README documents additional scan categories and output formats. Edges reflect visible calls or documented workflow; several scanner details and report wiring are not fully excerpted.
